### Scientific or user need
What is missing and why does it matter?

### Proposed equation or interface behavior
State the governing assumptions, temperatures, units and system topology.

### Evidence and sources
Provide the original paper/dataset URL, DOI, measured range and uncertainty where available.

### Verification plan
List analytical limits, numerical tests and any real dataset required.

### Scope/risks
Will this introduce a dependency, runtime cost or assumption that users might misunderstand?
